items.title: Backdoor in Claude Code for VS Code extension on the Cursor Marketplace
items.summary: A significant security breach has been reported involving a backdoor in the Claude Code VS Code extension available on the Cursor Marketplace. Developers should be aware of this vulnerability as it poses risks to their development environments and code integrity.

items.title: Northflank Breached
items.summary: Northflank has reported a security breach that may affect its users and their deployed applications. Developers using Northflank should take immediate precautions to secure their projects and data.

items.title: Azure's Weakest Link – Five Full Cross-Tenant Compromises
items.summary: A detailed analysis has uncovered five critical cross-tenant vulnerabilities within Azure, highlighting significant security risks for organizations using the platform. Engineers and security teams must evaluate their Azure configurations to mitigate potential threats.

items.title: AI isn't replacing SREs, it's deskilling them
items.summary: A new perspective on the impact of AI on Site Reliability Engineers (SREs) suggests that rather than replacing them, AI tools are leading to a deskilling effect. This raises important questions about the future of engineering roles and the need for continuous skill development.

items.title: Bunny CDN Security Incident
items.summary: Bunny CDN has reported a security incident that may affect its users' content delivery and security protocols. Developers relying on Bunny CDN should review their security measures and stay updated on the incident's developments.
